changes.override_reason: Chief direction was 'decrease', but the heuristic table and critic's EARLY_STALL diagnosis specifically call for increased thickness to delay LE stall; decreasing thickness would worsen the marginal stall-slope failure. Overriding to increase within the allowed interval.

changes.name: main_camber_pos
